card.name: Words introducing a reference or quotation
card.fires_on: The word or punctuation right after a verb of attribution ("wrote:") or a link to another passage ("than indicated", "determined in Step 1", "listed under", "see Special"). It fires where a back-reference or quoted text comes next.

modes.label: Quote lead-in
modes.description: The colon or the word wrote after a poster's name in email or forum replies, just before quoted text.
modes.example: Mon Nov 27 15:58:25 CET 2006 Michalis Giannakidis wrote<<: >>> > "obj[index] = value"

modes.label: Than indicated
modes.description: The word indicated after "lower initial dose of [drug] than", before "in the absence of an opioid".
modes.example: prescribe a lower initial dose of clorazepate dipotassium tablets than<< indicated>> in the absence of an opioid and tit

modes.label: Cross-reference
modes.description: A small word pointing to another step or section, such as in, under or Special.
modes.example: For consideration of a lower dose, see<< Special>> Considerations below.

card.plain: It marks spots where the text points back to something else, such as a quoted message, an earlier step or another section.
